tool_schemas.name: add-project
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new project (optionally as a sub-project under parent_project_id) and returns the newly created mirrored project record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is missing/empty, parent_project_id is malformed, or view_style is not one of the supported values; raises NOT_FOUND if parent_project_id is provided but does not exist or is not accessible; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if write rate limits are exceeded and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create projects.

parent_project_id.description: Optional local parent project id (creates a sub-project).

color.description: Project color identifier/name as supported by Todoist.

is_favorite.description: Whether the project is marked as a favorite.

tool_schemas.name: get-projects
tool_schemas.description: Lists mirrored projects matching the provided filters and returns a paged result set ordered by sort_by/sort_order; use limit and cursor to paginate, where cursor from a response fetches the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values, malformed IDs, or out-of-range limit, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read projects. May raise QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read rate limits are exceeded.

parent_project_id.description: Filter to projects with the given local parent project id.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get-project
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns a single mirrored project by project_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is malformed and NOT_FOUND if no accessible project exists for that id. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view the project and QUOTA_EXCEEDED on rate limiting.

tool_schemas.name: update-project
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on an existing project (including moving it via parent_project_id and changing lifecycle status) and returns the updated mirrored project. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, invalid enums, or an empty name when provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the project_id does not exist or is not accessible, or if parent_project_id is provided but does not exist; raises CONFLICT if the requested status transition is not allowed or the move would create an invalid hierarchy. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions and QUOTA_EXCEEDED on rate limiting.

color.description: New project color identifier/name as supported by Todoist.

parent_project_id.description: New local parent project id (move under another project).

status.description: Update the project lifecycle status (e.g., archive).

tool_schemas.name: delete-project
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the project identified by project_id and returns the deleted project (or deletion acknowledgement) reflecting its lifecycle change. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the project cannot be deleted in its current state. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions and QUOTA_EXCEEDED on rate limiting.

tool_schemas.name: get-project-collaborators
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of collaborators for the given project_id (as mirrored collaboration metadata). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is malformed and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or is not accessible. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot view collaborators for the project and QUOTA_EXCEEDED on rate limiting.

project_id.description: Local project id whose collaborators should be returned.

tool_schemas.name: add-task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new task and returns the newly created mirrored task record, optionally scoping it to a project, section, and/or parent_task_id and applying due/deadline/duration and labels. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/empty content, malformed IDs, invalid priority/duration values, or invalid datetime formats; raises NOT_FOUND if any referenced project_id/section_id/parent_task_id/label id does not exist or is not accessible; raises CONFLICT if the specified project/section/parent combination is inconsistent (e.g., section not in project). Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions and QUOTA_EXCEEDED on rate limiting.

project_id.description: Local project id to create the task in.

section_id.description: Local section id to create the task in.

parent_task_id.description: Local parent task id (create as a sub-task).

labels.description: List of local label ids to apply to the task.

due_datetime.description: Due date/time in ISO-8601 (maps to task due_date).

due_date_text.description: Natural-language due string stored alongside the due date.

deadline_date.description: Deadline date/time in ISO-8601 (maps to task deadline_date).

deadline_lang.description: Language code used to parse deadline text (maps to task deadline_lang).

tool_schemas.name: quick-add-task
tool_schemas.description: Parses the natural-language text, creates the task (optionally within the given project/section/parent context), attaches note if provided, and returns the created mirrored task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if text is empty, IDs are malformed, datetime formats are invalid, or duration fields are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if any provided project_id/section_id/parent_task_id does not exist or is not accessible; raises CONFLICT when the requested scoping is inconsistent (e.g., section not in project). Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions and QUOTA_EXCEEDED on rate limiting.

text.description: Natural language task text (e.g., 'Call Alex tomorrow 5pm #work').

note.description: Optional task description/notes to attach to the created task.

project_id.description: Local project id to scope the quick-add into (if supported).

section_id.description: Local section id to scope the quick-add into (if supported).

parent_task_id.description: Local parent task id (create as a sub-task) for quick-add.

due_datetime.description: Explicit due date/time override in ISO-8601.

deadline_date.description: Explicit deadline date/time override in ISO-8601.

deadline_lang.description: Language code used when parsing deadline-related text.

tool_schemas.name: get-task
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns a single mirrored task by task_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if task_id is malformed and NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist or is not accessible (including when deleted and not exposed by this read). Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions and QUOTA_EXCEEDED on rate limiting.

task_id.description: Local mirror task ID (tasks.id) to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: get-tasks
tool_schemas.description: Lists mirrored tasks matching the provided filters and returns a paged result set; results are sorted by sort/order and paginated with limit and an opaque cursor, where supplying cursor retrieves the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, invalid enum values, invalid datetime ranges/formats, or out-of-range limit, and NOT_FOUND if a referenced project_id/section_id/label id filter refers to an entity that does not exist or is not accessible. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions and QUOTA_EXCEEDED on rate limiting.

project_id.description: Filter tasks by local project ID (projects.id).

section_id.description: Filter tasks by local section ID (sections.id).

label_ids.description: Filter tasks to those containing all of the given local label IDs (labels.id).

due_from.description: Filter tasks with due_date on/after this timestamp (inclusive).

due_to.description: Filter tasks with due_date on/before this timestamp (inclusive).

search.description: Free-text search over task content/description (backend may use filter_cache_tokens).

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-tasks-completed-by-completion-date
tool_schemas.description: Returns completed tasks whose completion timestamp (completed_at) falls within the inclusive [from,to] range, optionally restricted to a single local project and/or to tasks that contain all provided local label IDs; results are returned in completion-time order and paged with limit (max 200) and an opaque cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if from/to are not valid date-times, from is after to, limit is out of range, or any ID fails its required format. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access to the referenced project/labels, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the request exceeds rate limits.

project_id.description: Optionally restrict to tasks completed in a given local project (projects.id).

label_ids.description: Optionally restrict to tasks that contain all given local label IDs (labels.id).

limit.description: Maximum number of completed tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-tasks-completed-by-due-date
tool_schemas.description: Returns completed tasks whose due_date falls within the inclusive [from,to] range (based on the task’s stored due_date at completion time), optionally restricted to a single local project and/or to tasks that contain all provided local label IDs; results are paged with limit (max 200) and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if from/to are invalid date-times, from is after to, limit is out of range, or any ID fails its required format. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access to the referenced project/labels, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limits are exceeded.

from.description: Start of due_date range (inclusive) for tasks that were completed.

to.description: End of due_date range (inclusive) for tasks that were completed.

project_id.description: Optionally restrict to tasks in a given local project (projects.id).

label_ids.description: Optionally restrict to tasks that contain all given local label IDs (labels.id).

limit.description: Maximum number of completed tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-productivity-stats
tool_schemas.description: Computes productivity statistics over tasks completed within the inclusive [from,to] window (by completed_at), optionally restricted to a local project and/or tasks containing all provided local label IDs, and returns aggregates bucketed by the requested group_by (day/week/month) using the provided IANA timezone (or the default when omitted). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if from/to are invalid or from is after to, group_by is not supported, timezone is not a valid IANA name, or any ID fails its required format. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access to the referenced project/labels, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limits are exceeded.

from.description: Start of analysis window based on completed_at timestamps (inclusive).

to.description: End of analysis window based on completed_at timestamps (inclusive).

project_id.description: Optionally restrict productivity stats to a given local project (projects.id).

label_ids.description: Optionally restrict stats to tasks containing all given local label IDs (labels.id).

group_by.description: Time bucketing to aggregate completed tasks.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for bucketing (e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles'); defaults to server/user setting.

tool_schemas.name: update-task
tool_schemas.description: Updates the specified local mirror task and propagates changes to Todoist, returning the updated task record as stored in the mirror after synchronization. Raises NOT_FOUND if task_id does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if any provided field is invalid (e.g., priority outside 1–4, duration_amount < 1, invalid enum values, malformed IDs), or if due/deadline/duration inputs are internally inconsistent (e.g., duration_unit without duration_amount). Raises CONFLICT if the requested move is not a valid state/relationship (e.g., section_id not in project_id, parent_task_id creates an invalid hierarchy, or attempting to modify a task that is deleted), FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the task or destination entities, UNAUTHORIZED if not authenticated, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limits are exceeded.

task_id.description: Local mirror task ID (tasks.id) to update.

project_id.description: Move task to the given local project (projects.id).

section_id.description: Move task to the given local section (sections.id).

parent_task_id.description: Make this task a subtask of the given local parent task (tasks.id).

label_ids.description: Replace task labels with the given local label IDs (labels.id).

due_date.description: Set an explicit due datetime (stored as tasks.due_date).

due_date_text.description: Set a natural-language due string (stored as tasks.due_date_text).

due_timezone.description: Timezone to associate with due date parsing/storage (stored as tasks.due_timezone).

deadline_date.description: Set an explicit deadline datetime (stored as tasks.deadline_date).

deadline_lang.description: Language hint for deadline parsing (stored as tasks.deadline_lang).

tool_schemas.name: close-task
tool_schemas.description: Closes (completes) the specified task in Todoist and returns the updated task state in the local mirror reflecting the completion. Raises NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist, CONFLICT if the task is already completed or is deleted, and VALIDATION_ERROR if task_id is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access to the task, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limits are exceeded.

task_id.description: Local mirror task ID (tasks.id) to close/complete.

tool_schemas.name: move-tasks
tool_schemas.description: Moves the provided tasks to the specified destination (project_id and/or section_id and/or parent_task_id) and returns the updated task records for the tasks that were moved; when many tasks are provided, the operation applies the same destination to all of them. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if task_ids is empty, any ID is malformed, or if no destination is provided, and NOT_FOUND if any referenced task or destination entity does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the move is not allowed (e.g., section_id not in project_id, parent_task_id is one of task_ids or creates an invalid hierarchy, or any task is deleted), plus UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for authentication, access control, or rate limiting failures.

task_ids.description: List of local mirror task IDs (tasks.id) to move.

parent_task_id.description: Destination local parent task ID (tasks.id) to make tasks subtasks of.

tool_schemas.name: delete-task
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified task in Todoist and marks it deleted in the local mirror, returning the final mirrored task state (or a deletion acknowledgement, depending on client settings). Raises NOT_FOUND if task_id does not exist, CONFLICT if the task is already deleted, and VALIDATION_ERROR if task_id is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access to the task, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limits are exceeded.

task_id.description: Local task id to delete (mirrored Todoist task).

tool_schemas.name: reopen-task
tool_schemas.description: Reopens a previously closed (completed) task in Todoist and returns the updated task state in the local mirror as active. Raises NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist, CONFLICT if the task is not currently completed or is deleted, and VALIDATION_ERROR if task_id is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access to the task, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limits are exceeded.

task_id.description: Local task id to reopen (previously completed).

tool_schemas.name: get-tasks-by-filter
tool_schemas.description: Runs a Todoist filter query and returns matching tasks from the local mirror (optionally constrained by lifecycle status), sorted by the requested sort_by/sort_order, and paged with limit (max 200) and an opaque cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filter is empty, limit is out of range, sort_by/sort_order/status are not supported, or cursor is invalid for this query. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the filter requests tasks in projects the caller cannot access, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limits are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

sort_by.description: Field to sort the returned tasks by.

status.description: Filter by task lifecycle status in the local mirror.

tool_schemas.name: add-section
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new section under the specified local project, propagates the creation to Todoist, and returns the created section as stored in the local mirror (including its resolved order within the project). Raises NOT_FOUND if project_id does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is malformed, name is empty, or order is not an integer when provided. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot modify the project, CONFLICT if a section cannot be created due to the project’s current state (e.g., project is deleted), UNAUTHORIZED if not authenticated, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limits are exceeded.

project_id.description: Local project id to add the section to.

tool_schemas.name: get-section
tool_schemas.description: Returns the section identified by `section_id`, including its project linkage and current lifecycle fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `section_id` does not match the expected format, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the owning project, and NOT_FOUND if no such section exists (or it is not visible to the caller). May raise RATE_LIMITED when upstream or account quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get-sections
tool_schemas.description: Lists sections for the given `project_id`, optionally filtered by `status` and sorted by `sort_by`/`sort_order`; returns a page of results of size up to `limit` plus an opaque `cursor` to fetch the next page (omit `cursor` to start from the first page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, unsupported sort combinations, or out-of-range `limit`, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the project, and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist (or is not visible to the caller). May raise RATE_LIMITED when upstream or account quotas are exceeded.

project_id.description: Local project id whose sections should be listed.

status.description: Filter returned sections by lifecycle status.

limit.description: Maximum number of sections to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

sort_by.description: Field to sort the returned sections by.

tool_schemas.name: update-section
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on the section (`name` and/or `order`) and returns the updated section record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if no updatable fields are provided, `name` is empty, `section_id` is invalid, or `order` is not an integer, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot modify the section’s project, and NOT_FOUND if the section does not exist (or is not visible to the caller). May raise CONFLICT if the section is deleted or otherwise not in an updatable state, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: delete-section
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the section identified by `section_id` and returns the section in its deleted lifecycle state (or a deletion confirmation, depending on client settings). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `section_id` is malformed, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot modify the owning project, and NOT_FOUND if the section does not exist (or is not visible to the caller). May raise CONFLICT if the section is already deleted or cannot be deleted due to lifecycle constraints, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: add-comment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new comment attached to a task (`target_type=task`) or project (`target_type=project`) and returns the created comment including any provided opaque `attachment`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `content` is empty, `target_type` is invalid, the required target id (`task_id` or `project_id`) is missing/invalid, or both target ids are provided in a way that conflicts with `target_type`; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the target. Raises NOT_FOUND if the target task/project does not exist (or is not visible), CONFLICT if the target is deleted/archived and cannot accept new comments, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

target_type.description: What the comment is attached to (task or project).

task_id.description: Local task id to attach the comment to (required when target_type=task).

project_id.description: Local project id to attach the comment to (required when target_type=project).

attachment.description: Optional attachment payload (stored as an opaque object).

tool_schemas.name: get-comment
tool_schemas.description: Returns the comment identified by `comment_id`, including its target reference and lifecycle fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `comment_id` is malformed, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the comment’s target, and NOT_FOUND if the comment does not exist (or is not visible to the caller). May raise RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get-comments
tool_schemas.description: Lists comments attached to the specified `target_type` and target id, optionally filtered by `status` and sorted by `sort`; returns up to `limit` comments plus an opaque `cursor` for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `target_type` is invalid, the required target id is missing/invalid, `limit` is out of range, or `sort` is unsupported; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the target. Raises NOT_FOUND if the target task/project does not exist (or is not visible), and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

target_type.description: Return comments attached to a task or a project.

task_id.description: Local task id to list comments for (required when target_type=task).

project_id.description: Local project id to list comments for (required when target_type=project).

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: update-comment
tool_schemas.description: Updates a comment’s `content` and/or `attachment` and returns the updated comment. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `comment_id` is invalid, no updatable fields are provided, or updated `content` is empty, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot modify the comment, and NOT_FOUND if the comment does not exist (or is not visible to the caller). May raise CONFLICT if the comment is deleted or otherwise not in an editable state, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

attachment.description: Updated attachment payload (stored as an opaque object).

tool_schemas.name: delete-comment
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the comment identified by `comment_id` and returns the comment in its deleted lifecycle state (or a deletion confirmation, depending on client settings). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `comment_id` is malformed, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot delete the comment, and NOT_FOUND if the comment does not exist (or is not visible to the caller). May raise CONFLICT if the comment is already deleted or cannot be deleted due to lifecycle constraints, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get-task-comments
tool_schemas.description: Lists comments for the task identified by `task_id`, optionally filtered by `status` and sorted by `sort`; returns up to `limit` comments plus an opaque `cursor` for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `task_id` is invalid, `limit` is out of range, or `sort` is unsupported, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the task, and NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist (or is not visible to the caller). May raise RATE_LIMITED when upstream or account quotas are exceeded.

task_id.description: Local task id to list comments for.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-project-comments
tool_schemas.description: Lists comments associated with the specified project and returns a paged collection of comment records filtered by lifecycle status and ordered by the requested sort. Results are paginated with limit and an opaque cursor; when more results are available, the response includes a next cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id/status/limit/sort are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the project, NOT_FOUND if the project_id does not exist (or is not visible to the caller), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request-rate or sync limits are exceeded.

project_id.description: Local project id to list comments for.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: add-label
tool_schemas.description: Adds the specified label to the specified task and returns the updated task (or task label set) reflecting the association. The operation is idempotent: adding a label that is already present succeeds without creating a duplicate. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if task_id/label_id are malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot modify the task, NOT_FOUND if the task or label does not exist (or is not visible to the caller), CONFLICT if the task is in a non-modifiable lifecycle state (for example deleted), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request-rate limits are exceeded.

task_id.description: Local task id to add the label to.

label_id.description: Local label id to add to the task.

tool_schemas.name: delete-label
tool_schemas.description: Deletes (removes) a label from the user’s Todoist domain and returns the deleted label record (or a deletion acknowledgement) with updated lifecycle status in the mirror. This is a destructive lifecycle transition; after deletion the label is no longer available for assignment. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if label_id is malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot manage labels, NOT_FOUND if the label_id does not exist (or is not visible to the caller), CONFLICT if the label is already removed, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request-rate limits are exceeded.

label_id.description: Local label id to delete (mirrored Todoist label).

tool_schemas.name: update-label
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields of a label (name, color, favorite flag) and returns the updated label record. Fields not provided are left unchanged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if label_id is malformed or if any provided field value is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot manage labels, NOT_FOUND if the label does not exist (or is not visible to the caller), CONFLICT if the label is in a removed state and cannot be updated, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request-rate limits are exceeded.

is_favorite.description: Whether the label is marked as favorite.

tool_schemas.name: get-label
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single label by local label_id and returns the label record as mirrored from Todoist, including its lifecycle and flags. This endpoint does not paginate because it returns at most one entity. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if label_id is malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access labels, NOT_FOUND if the label_id does not exist (or is not visible to the caller), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request-rate limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get-labels
tool_schemas.description: Lists labels in the user’s domain and returns a paged collection filtered by lifecycle status and optional favorite/shared flags, sorted by the requested field and direction. Results are paginated with limit and an opaque cursor; when more results are available, the response includes a next cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter/sort/order/limit/cursor is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access labels, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request-rate limits are exceeded.

is_favorite.description: If provided, returns only labels that match favorite flag.

is_shared.description: If provided, returns only labels that match shared flag.

limit.description: Maximum number of labels to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-shared-labels
tool_schemas.description: Lists shared labels and returns a paged collection optionally filtered by shared_origin, sorted by the requested field and direction. Results are paginated with limit and an opaque cursor; when more results are available, the response includes a next cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if shared_origin/sort/order/limit/cursor are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access shared labels, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request-rate limits are exceeded.

shared_origin.description: Filter shared labels by how they were shared/identified.

limit.description: Maximum number of shared labels to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: remove-shared-label
tool_schemas.description: Removes a shared label from the user’s account and returns the updated shared-label record (or a removal acknowledgement) reflecting the new lifecycle status. The operation is idempotent: removing a shared label that is already removed succeeds without additional side effects. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if label_id is malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot manage shared labels, NOT_FOUND if the shared label does not exist (or is not visible to the caller), CONFLICT if the label is in a state that cannot be removed, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request-rate limits are exceeded.

label_id.description: Local shared label id to remove.

tool_schemas.name: rename-shared-label
tool_schemas.description: Renames a shared label and returns the updated shared-label record. Only the name is changed; other fields remain unchanged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if label_id is malformed or name is invalid/empty, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot manage shared labels, NOT_FOUND if the shared label does not exist (or is not visible to the caller), CONFLICT if the label is removed or otherwise not renameable, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request-rate limits are exceeded.

label_id.description: Local shared label id to rename.

name.description: New name for the shared label.

tool_schemas.name: sync-todoist-domain
tool_schemas.description: Pulls the latest domain objects from Todoist for the authenticated user and upserts them into the local mirror (projects, sections, tasks, labels, comments). Returns a summary of created/updated/unchanged counts per entity type. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the Todoist access token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if scopes do not permit sync, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when upstream or local rate limits are exceeded.

todoist_access_token.description: Todoist OAuth access token presented as a Bearer token for upstream API calls.

sync_mode.description: Whether to perform a full resync or an incremental sync based on last_sync_at.

since.description: When sync_mode=incremental, only pull changes since this timestamp (server may clamp to a safe minimum).

include_deleted.description: When true, also sync deleted/removed objects where Todoist provides tombstones; otherwise deleted objects may be discovered only via local operations.

tool_schemas.name: upsert-task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new task or updates an existing one idempotently by todoist_task_id and returns the mirrored task record. If todoist_task_id already exists, updates that row instead of inserting a duplicate. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, invalid enums, invalid dates, or missing required fields; raises NOT_FOUND if referenced project_id/section_id/parent_task_id do not exist; raises CONFLICT if attempting to modify a deleted task in a way not permitted by lifecycle; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions; may raise QUOTA_EXCEEDED on write rate limiting.

todoist_access_token.description: Todoist OAuth access token presented as a Bearer token for upstream API calls.

todoist_task_id.description: Upstream Todoist task id used for idempotency (if present in the mirror, the task is updated).

project_id.description: Local project id the task belongs to.

section_id.description: Optional local section id; must belong to the same project_id.

parent_task_id.description: Optional local parent task id for subtasks.

label_ids.description: Full replacement list of local label ids attached to the task.

due_date_text.description: Natural-language due string (as captured from quick add or user input).

due_timezone.description: IANA timezone name for due date interpretation (e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles').

deadline_lang.description: Language code used to parse deadline/due text (e.g., 'en').

duration_amount.description: Estimated duration amount (must be paired with duration_unit).

created_by_quick_add.description: Whether the task originated from quick add.

quick_add_raw_text.description: Raw quick-add text captured for analytics/idempotency.

status.description: Lifecycle status to set; server enforces valid transitions.

tool_schemas.name: get-whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated identity for the current request, including the effective scopes/entitlements and current rate-limit or quota consumption snapshot. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid credential is presented.

todoist_access_token.description: Todoist OAuth access token presented as a Bearer token for upstream API calls (used to resolve the caller identity and permitted scopes).

metadata.name: Todoist Integration Server
metadata.description: This backend stores a local, API-driven mirror of a user's Todoist domain objects (projects, sections, tasks, labels, comments) plus minimal collaboration metadata, to support CRUD, completion/reopen workflows, and filter-based task search. The integration server primarily brokers requests to Todois
